source_snapshot.procedure: Confirm SUT configuration, clear logs, attempt to roll back AST1060 images with an invalid/revoked SVN, then collect results/photos and unexpected logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: Confirm that the platform blocks the update
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: Use a deliberately corrupt or older AST1060 image, assume a BMC UpdateService submission, and infer rejection from an error and unchanged BMC `mc info`.

original_test_intent.purpose: Verify that the platform's AST1060 Root-of-Trust anti-rollback policy explicitly rejects an otherwise applicable owner-approved negative firmware fixture whose Security Version Number is invalid or revoked, without changing AST1060 firmware/security/boot state.
original_test_intent.target: The AST1060 firmware update path and anti-rollback policy for one exact board/BMC/AST1060 hardware and policy state; not the BMC firmware version reported by generic `mc info` or an arbitrary corrupt image.
original_test_intent.scope: A supervised negative update submission using the exact signed/structured invalid-or-revoked-SVN fixture(s) defined by the platform owner, verification of a policy-specific rejection before activation, unchanged AST1060 SVN/version/policy and complete management/boot/recovery health.
original_test_intent.operation: Record AST1060 identity, current firmware/SVN/policy and recovery state; verify the negative fixture offline; submit it once through the exact approved platform update route; monitor the returned task/status and RoT evidence; stop immediately on any acceptance/staging/activation ambiguity; prove unchanged state and platform health without arbitrary retries.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: One attempt per owner-required invalid/revoked-SVN negative fixture; the source lists 60 attended and 60 machine minutes but does not authorize retries or replacement with a generic corrupt image.
original_test_intent.expected_result: The update mechanism reaches the anti-rollback/SVN policy check and returns the exact approved rejection class before firmware activation; AST1060 image/version/SVN/policy, boot, BMC/OOB and protected firmware remain unchanged and healthy.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: Board/BMC/AST1060 identity, current image/version/SVN/policy floor, negative fixture filename/hash/signature/target/SVN/revocation provenance, endpoint/tool/profile, authorization, raw request/task/rejection code and stage, no activation/reboot, pre/post AST1060 state, POST/boot/BMC/OOB/SEL and recovery readiness.
ambiguities: The source does not identify the AST1060 build/policy, SVN floor/revocation semantics, exact negative fixture(s), update route, rejection code/stage or recovery.
It is unclear whether both invalid and revoked SVN cases are required or whether one platform-defined negative category is selected.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly rejects DeepSeek's generic corrupt/older image and `mc info` proof, requires a signed SVN-specific fixture and critical recovery, and prohibits submission before review. It converts missing provisionable policy/fixture/endpoint/recovery inputs into permanent BLOCKED even though the purpose and negative operation are technically clear.

applicable_history.decision: The row was restored to the historical V2 sequence after a prior missing-row integrity issue; its source identity must remain physical XLSX row 241 / Wistron-HW-00256-V002.

A missing vendor policy, signed negative fixture, endpoint or recovery is a readiness dependency rather than permanent BLOCKED when the test purpose is understandable and can be executed after provision.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: V3 reclassifies this clear but critical negative update test from BLOCKED to REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION. No action is ready now: the exact anti-rollback policy, SVN-specific signed fixture, advertised update route, policy rejection semantics, stable power and independent recovery must all be supplied and approved.

available_now: The requested behavior is explicitly AST1060 downgrade rejection based on invalid/revoked SVN, not generic image corruption.

ASPEED identifies AST1060 as a platform Root-of-Trust device implementing firmware protection, detection and recovery functions; public material does not provide this platform's SVN fixture or endpoint.
Read-only AST1060/BMC/board/current-version and recovery inventory can be collected without submitting an image.

revision_candidate.test_name: AST1060 Invalid or Revoked SVN Downgrade Rejection
revision_candidate.purpose: Submit the owner-approved AST1060 negative firmware fixture for the specified invalid/revoked SVN condition and verify an explicit anti-rollback rejection with no firmware, SVN, policy or boot-state change.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The exact board/BMC/AST1060 firmware and anti-rollback policy implementation with owner-generated signed negative fixture, documented update route, stable power, isolated maintenance and independent OOB recovery.
revision_candidate.target_scope: AST1060 anti-rollback/SVN enforcement only. Generic corruption, signature rejection, BMC firmware downgrade and arbitrary older images are different tests and cannot substitute.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: AST1060/board/BMC identity; current image/version/SVN/policy floor/revocations; authoritative policy; applicable signed fixture(s) and hashes; exact update endpoint/tool/task schema; expected SVN-policy rejection code/stage/timeout; credentials/TLS; approval; power/window/OOB; recovery/no-retry procedure.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Preserve complete state, verify the negative fixture offline, pause for final approval, submit it once through the exact documented AST1060 update route, capture the raw request/task lifecycle and policy-specific rejection, abort on acceptance or ambiguous staging, then independently re-read AST1060 version/SVN/policy and verify POST/boot/BMC/OOB/SEL health without clearing evidence or retrying.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Target and current policy proven; fixture target/signature/format/SVN provenance peer reviewed; exact endpoint and rejection semantics qualified; stable power and protected credentials/TLS; maintenance isolation; monitoring/evidence path; no-retry/abort and recovery tested; final approval active.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Approval and identity manifest; current AST1060 version/SVN/policy; fixture hash/signature/target/SVN/revocation record; exact tool/endpoint/request; complete task/status and policy rejection code/stage/timestamps; no activation/reboot; unchanged post-state; POST/boot/BMC/OOB/SEL health; recovery readiness.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The platform/RoT owner's AST1060 anti-rollback and SVN policy, negative-fixture definition and platform-qualified update/recovery specification. Public AST1060 product material is contextual, not the policy acceptance source.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Never use arbitrary corrupt/old images, assume transport failure proves anti-rollback, invent an endpoint, expose credentials, clear logs, automate retries, accept any staging/activation ambiguity or power-cycle/reset outside the approved recovery plan.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: RoT/security and firmware owners approve the fixture, target and expected rejection; BMC/lab/service owners approve the exact submission, power/window and recovery; explicit final confirmation is required immediately before the one allowed submission.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Owners create and adjudicate the security fixture/policy and supervise recovery. Once fully qualified, the single submission, task monitoring and read-only evidence collection may be automated; no automatic retry or recovery is allowed.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: If the fixture is accepted, state changes, the task is ambiguous or management/boot health degrades, stop without retry, preserve all request/task/security evidence, maintain stable power, invoke only the validated AST1060/platform recovery under qualified control, verify protected firmware and quarantine unresolved security state.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Target/policy/fixture mismatch, unproven SVN-gate reachability, invalid signature/format for the intended case, unqualified endpoint, missing final approval/recovery, unstable power, transport-only error, acceptance/staging/activation indication, version/SVN/policy delta, BMC/OOB/POST/boot loss, incomplete security evidence or recovery failure.

identified_defects: V2 overuses BLOCKED for provisionable anti-rollback policy, negative fixture, endpoint and recovery inputs.
DeepSeek's corrupt/older image can test signature/format rejection rather than SVN anti-rollback and its `mc info` check does not identify AST1060 state.
Neither source nor V2 defines whether invalid and revoked SVN require separate fixtures/attempts; the owner must resolve exact coverage.
reason_for_change: Separate clear technical capability from current readiness, ensure the negative fixture reaches the SVN policy gate rather than an earlier parser/signature failure, and make the one-shot security update evidence and recovery contract auditable.

new_technical_evidence.title: ASPEED Root of Trust Security IC (PRoT)
new_technical_evidence.applicability: AST1060 product context only; platform policy and endpoint remain owner-specific
new_technical_evidence.supports: AST1060 is a platform Root-of-Trust device with internal flash/SRAM and real-time I2C/SPI filtering in a firmware protection/detection/recovery architecture.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The public page does not define this platform's SVN policy, fixture format, update API, rejection code or recovery sequence.

removed_ambiguities: Distinguishes an SVN-specific negative fixture from a corrupt, unsigned or merely older image.
Requires policy-stage rejection and unchanged AST1060 SVN/state instead of generic upload failure or BMC `mc info`.
Limits execution to the owner-defined fixture count with no automatic retry.
resolved_blockers: The test intent and operation are technically understandable; missing vendor policy, fixture, endpoint and recovery are supply/approval gates, so capability is REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION.
remaining_blockers: No submission until target/policy/SVN fixture/route/rejection semantics, stable power, final approval and independent recovery are verified.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 removes an over-BLOCKED capability label without authorizing execution, preserves the critical one-shot gate, and strengthens evidence so an earlier signature/transport rejection cannot be mistaken for AST1060 SVN enforcement; public ASPEED context is kept separate from owner-specific policy facts.

agent_understanding_result.notes: This critical BLOCKED-to-REQUIRES negative security update contract is queued for isolated validation.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: The source requires AST1060 rollback images with invalid/revoked SVN to be blocked by the platform.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 correctly rejects generic corrupt images but turns missing provisionable policy/fixture/endpoint/recovery into permanent BLOCKED.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Allow only one final-approved submission of an applicable signed SVN-negative fixture through the exact route, require policy-specific rejection and unchanged AST1060 state, and prohibit automatic retry or improvised recovery.
